definitions.full: H2786. charaq חָרַק verb gnash or grind the teeth , only in poetry (Late Hebrew id. ; Arabic file, rub together, grate or grind (teeth); Aramaic id .) — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular ׳ח Job 16:9 ; Imperfect יַחֲרֹק Psa 112:10 ; וַיַּחַרְקוּֿ Lam 2:16 ; Infinitive absolute חָרֹק Psa 35:16 ; Participle חֹרֵק 37:12 ; — grind the teeth in rage against: ׳ח על שׁניו 37:12 ; 35:16 absolute without על 112:10 ; Lam 2:16 (only here with שֵׁן singular); with בְּ instrumental (Ges § 119 , 3 b, R. Da Synt, § 73 R. 6 ) ׳ח עלֿ בשׁניו Job 16:9 .
